entries.msgstr: A special daily reward given to players on the Leaderboard.
When playing in a Platoon, you can receive additional credits and experience.
You can receive additional credits by playing in a Platoon.
Receive an additional {brown_Open}%(value)s{brown_Close} to Combat XP after each battle when playing in a Platoon with other players.
